name: Remix: Pragmatic Lexicon
description: Pragmatic Lexicon is a high-performance English vocabulary building and active-recall flashcard app tailored for software engineers, professionals, and communicators. Features 1,400+ curated terms across letters A–Z empowering engineers to speak articulately, write clear technical documentation, present confidently, and converse with colleagues and friends, complete with dual English/Tamil context examples, comprehensive thesaurus, British pronunciation, and 3D study cards.
